caption: The drawing depicts three metal tools arranged side by side against a plain, light beige background. The first tool, on the left, is a shovel with a wide, flat blade and a long, straight handle ending in an oval loop; its blade has three prominent rivets near its slightly curved top edge. The second tool, in the center, appears to be a pair of tongs with a scissor-like mechanism and notched gripping jaws; it has a pair of circular grips at the pivot joint, and its handles are straight with rounded ends. The third tool, on the right, is a long poker or similar instrument with a pointed tip and a rounded knob at the end of its handle. All three tools have a muted, metallic gray-brown color with areas of dark shading and distress, showing signs of wear, rust, and patina. The composition places the objects standing upright, with their handles and lengths overlapping and touching each other, casting subtle shadows on the neutral background.
title: Zoar Fire Tongs, Poker and Shovel
